description: Yuno, 20-year-old female cartographer. Four-and-a-half heads tall, round cheeks, soft stocky build. Dark chestnut thick single braid to middle back, dark green eyes. Moss-green waist jacket, pale pink shirt, loose brown trousers, brown shoes. Flat oval map case on back. Hands hold half-open accordion-folded paper map at waist. Warm gentle face. No hat or cloak.
